The '''NA LCS 2013 Summer''' split was the second split of the 2013 North American LCS season, held from June 12 to September 1, 2013. Eight teams competed in a quadruple round-robin Regular Season, with all matches being best-of-one. The top six teams advanced to the Playoffs, which were played in a single-elimination format. All matches were best-of-three, except for the Final, which was best-of-five.
The winner of the split qualified for the [[World_Championship/2013|2013 World Championship]] and secured a spot in the [[Battle_Of_The_Atlantic/2013|2013 Battle of the Atlantic]]. The split was organized by Riot Games and held in Los Angeles and Seattle, United States, with the Finals taking place at PAX 2013.

==Format==
* Group Stage

**All matches are {{Abbr/Bo1}}
**Top 6 advance for playoffs
**Top 2 receive playoffs byes into the semifinals
*Playoffs
** Single Elimination 
** Matches are {{Abbr/Bo3}} 
**Final is {{Abbr/Bo5}}
* Top 3 Qualifies for [[World_Championship/2013|2013 World Championship]]
* Top 5 Qualifies for [[Battle_Of_The_Atlantic/2013|Battle of the Atlantic 2013]]
